title: 👉 "You Can Say That Again" Doesn't Mean Repeat! (Don't Say This!) #Shorts #EnglishLearning

subtitles.en: Honestly, this studio coffee is the only thing keeping me alive today.
subtitles.zh: 說真的，今天全靠攝影棚這杯咖啡續命了。

subtitles.en: Oh, you can say that again.
subtitles.zh: 吼，真的不能同意你更多！

subtitles.en: Okay, I said this coffee is the only thing keeping me alive?
subtitles.zh: 好喔，那我再說一次：這杯咖啡是讓我撐下去的動力？

subtitles.en: No, no, I didn't mean literally.
subtitles.zh: 不是啦，我不是叫你字面上真的再講一次！

subtitles.en: But you asked me to say it again?
subtitles.zh: 但妳不是叫我「say it again」嗎？

subtitles.en: In conversation, this is not a request to repeat.
subtitles.zh: 在日常對話中，這可不是叫對方重複一遍喔。

subtitles.en: It actually means I totally agree with you.
subtitles.zh: 它的意思其實是「我超級贊同你的話」。
重點完全在於加強認同的語氣。

subtitles.en: Ah, so it is like a super…
So if the coffee is great, you would say…
subtitles.zh: 所以要是咖啡超好喝，你就會說……
